description: The mutation campaign for P-022 step 7a checkpoint 3 (the AnalysisTrace, #269: stable-ID normalization and declared per-layer ordering semantics). Separate from the cp1/cp2 campaigns on purpose — each checkpoint's evidence stays frozen at what it measured. Every mutation edits a PRODUCTION surface — ownlang/repro.py or rust/crates/own-shadow/src/ — never a test. Four layers run for every mutation (discipline 3: no fail-fast). M00 is the harness-honesty control.

control.description: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers

mutations.description: the reference derives a handle's stable id from the counter instead of the record's identity
mutations.rule: trace: internal identifiers are normalized away by IDENTITY, never by position
expected_catchers: python::non-zero exit with no FAIL line

mutations.description: the reference drops `line` from a handle's identity, fusing two facts on one line-distinct site
mutations.rule: trace: the rename is a BIJECTION — it may not fuse two facts into one address

mutations.description: the reference stops disambiguating a repeated address
mutations.rule: trace: a duplicate address takes a ~<n> suffix, inside the bracket
mutations.pattern: \ \ \ \ return\ address\ if\ n\ ==\ 0\ else\ f"\{address\}\~\{n\}"

mutations.description: the reference declares the lowered layer's order canonical, licensing a sort
mutations.rule: trace: order is DECLARED, never normalized away — lowered order is semantic (BR-D4/BR-L5)
mutations.pattern: \ \ \ \ "lowered":\ ORDER_SIGNIFICANT,\ \ \ \ \#\ BR\-D4\ /\ BR\-L5:\ document\ \+\ lowering\ order
mutations.replacement: "lowered": ORDER_CANONICAL,    # BR-D4 / BR-L5: document + lowering order

mutations.description: the reference declares the verdict layer's order canonical, hiding a tie-order defect
mutations.rule: trace: BR-V8 leaves ties in construction order, so position carries information
mutations.pattern: \ \ \ \ "verdicts":\ ORDER_SIGNIFICANT,\ \ \ \#\ BR\-V8:\ ties\ stay\ in\ construction\ order
mutations.replacement: "verdicts": ORDER_CANONICAL,   # BR-V8: ties stay in construction order

mutations.description: the reference narrows the minted-handle pattern so `loc_` names leak through unrewritten
mutations.rule: trace: the rename is TOTAL — no counter-shaped name survives

mutations.description: the reference gives a refused layer an empty step list AND drops its error
mutations.rule: trace: a refused layer carries its error and no steps

mutations.description: the port derives a handle's stable id from the counter instead of the record's identity
mutations.rule: trace: internal identifiers are normalized away by IDENTITY, never by position

mutations.description: the port declares the lowered layer's order canonical, licensing a sort
mutations.rule: trace: order is DECLARED, never normalized away

mutations.description: the port stops asserting that the handle rewrite is total
mutations.rule: trace: a claim nothing can falsify is not a contract

mutations.description: the port drops the mint kind from the handle record
mutations.rule: trace: the mint kind is preserved as a comparable VALUE so a routing difference stays one step
